# Shared domain fixtures

`shared-v1.json` publishes `synthetic:domain-conformance@v1` with canonical
world/account/resource/asset/cohort/institution IDs, exact mechanism declarations,
finite claims and independently specified expected amounts. It is synthetic and
not a real-world source or empirical model. See the
[domain harness guide](../../../engine/poliscope_engine/domains/README.md) for
identity reuse, the independent arithmetic oracle, authoring API, counterpart
acceptance and transition limitations. Keep expected values independent of the
production evaluator. Changes to these fixture semantics require a new version.

`provisioning-economy-v1.json` publishes the independent real-adapter arrangement
`synthetic:provisioning-economy@v1`: actual economy care/training and access feed
actual provisioning production/freight/storage/use. It retains both settlements,
overlapping regional views, one canonical time budget and prior care fulfillment.
The expected accounts/claims and conservation derivation are literal data, never
regenerated from evaluator output. `provisioning_economy_fixture.py` supplies only
trusted construction/review bindings. Source models remain inactive; the common
DAG observations are partial and the all-domain static gate remains open.

`provisioning-education-v1.json` publishes `synthetic:provisioning-education@v1`.
Actual DOM-06 policy/student/staff/supply and facility prerequisites feed actual
production/freight/storage/use. The same cohort supplies student and staff time;
its one 14 h book also funds care, production and freight. Education consumes
2 kg from the canonical raw stock. The disjoint 3-slot facility pool retains a
prior posting/hold and a competing claim. Expected accounts/claims and conservation
are literal independently authored data; helper code constructs trusted bindings
only. No learning, scientific validity or all-domain education gate is claimed.

`provisioning-health-v1.json` is a synthetic real DOM-01/07 fixture: 14 shared
hours split across ordinary care, beneficiary care, clinical staff and finite
production/freight; 20 opening kg, supply use, physical losses and remote final
use reconcile independently. Prior postings/holds and overlapping views remain;
clinic slots use a disjoint pool. Health needs/exposure/state are descriptive
references. No delivered treatment, health change or quantitative need coverage
is implied. Independent shortage/access/policy/context cases use the actual
health and provisioning evaluators through the common conformance harness.

`provisioning-infrastructure-v1.json` is an independently authored synthetic
DOM-01/08 host fixture: one 5-slot depot, bridge and road book supplies explicit
prerequisites for the existing finite economy/provisioning chain. Its slots never
convert to kg or merge with material/time accounts. Tests vary bottlenecks and
queues using independent integer/Fraction oracles and preserve holds/prior
commitments, distinct reach failures and stale-context rejection. It supplies
bounded conformance only, with no empirical validation or parent acceptance.

`provisioning-continuity-v1.json` is an explicitly hypothetical real-adapter
DOM-01/12 fixture: four response commitments gate production, freight, storage
and use with one disjoint finite response book. Literal material/time balances
and integer slot oracles are independent of implementation output. Hazard and
exposure references certify no empirical risk, damage, recovery or aid delivery.

`provisioning-environment-v1.json` uses the actual finite DOM-10 extraction/sink
composition and DOM-01/02 work/production/freight/storage/use chain over one book.
Independent literal balances and Fraction oracles include exact residual plus loss
sink debits. Synthetic coefficients establish neither absorption nor scientific
validity. Host context, explicit reviews and unknown/denied inputs remain tested.

`economy-governance-v1.json` is a synthetic actual DOM-02/03 host fixture. Ten
canonical hours supply administration 3 (one previously posted), reserved care 2
and work 5, leaving 2 unmet. Twelve goods and 5 entitlement units permit use 5,
retaining stock 7 and unmet demand 3. Its equal-member ballot is hypothetical;
no policy adoption, behavioral effect, public numerical IPC or gate is implied.

`economy-adjudication-v1.json` is the synthetic actual DOM-02/04 counterpart:
ten shared hours, three case hours (one already posted), two reserved care hours,
and five remaining work hours. An explicit upheld host case permits existing
goods terms to consume five of twelve stock units and five finite entitlements.
Rights/rationale are hypothetical host assertions, with no inferred legal merits,
rights creation, enforcement or source activation. Independent finite feasibility
oracles, partial work, conflicts, unknowns and stale/forged context checks exercise
the actual adapters; see the
[package record](../../../docs/roadmap/execution/WP-032-counterparts-economy-adjudication.md).

`economy-care-v1.json` is a synthetic DOM-02/05 fixture with two overlapping
arrangements sharing one ten-person cohort, 12 h of dated time, a prior 1 h care
posting and a 2 h care hold. Total care 3 h, training 3 h and paid work 6 h exhaust
time; a request for 8 kg receives 4 kg from 20 kg stock under 4 entitlements.
Obligations and capacities are authored inputs, not empirical care requirements.

`economy-education-v1.json` is a literal synthetic DOM-02/06 fixture: one cohort's
12 h covers care 3, student 3, staff 2 and employment 4; 20 kg stock and 4 existing
rights cover materials 2 and goods 2. Independent facility capacity 3 covers
seat 2 and competing use 1. Prior care/seat postings and holds are retained once.
It supplies no empirical learning or synchronized delivery claim. Tests derive
finite time, stock/entitlement and facility expectations independently.

`economy-health-v1.json` is a literal synthetic DOM-02/07 fixture. One cohort's
12 h covers other care 3 (including 1 prior), patient care 3, staff 2 and
employment 4, with employment unmet 4. Supplies 2 and goods 2 consume 4 kg and
4 existing entitlements; 16 kg remains. Separate facility capacity 3 covers
patient slots 2 (including 1 prior) and other use 1. Integer/Fraction oracles,
queue/procedure changes and replay check independent constraints. Quantities do
not establish demand coverage, treatment, attendance or health outcomes.

`economy-infrastructure-v1.json` is a literal synthetic DOM-02/08 fixture. One
cohort has 12 h: care 3 (including 1 prior), training 3 and employment 6 (2 unmet).
Goods receive 5 kg from 20 kg under 5 existing entitlements, leaving 15 kg and
3 unmet. Separate facility, bridge and road books each hold 5 slots; four explicit
one-slot demands leave 1 each. Care explicitly declares independence, other claims
name full reach prerequisites. Finite feasible-set/Fraction oracles, replay, holds,
queue/procedure alternatives and two-scope tests check conservation. This models
prerequisites, not empirical demand, synchronized delivery or operating resources.

`governance-adjudication-v1.json` is a literal synthetic DOM-03/04 fixture: one
canonical cohort has 10 hours, decision work needs 3 (1 previously posted), care
holds 2, and legal work requests 7. Decision approval leaves 5 hours for the case,
which remains capacity-blocked with 2 hours unmet. Stock and entitlements remain
12 kg and 5 respectively. The two local scopes overlap through canonical identities;
tests also exercise explicitly authored regional/local jurisdiction. No model of
legal merits, policy adoption, enforcement or scientific validity is implied.


`governance-education-v1.json` is a literal synthetic DOM-03/06 fixture. Twelve cohort hours fund decision 3, care 3, student 3, staff 2 and employment 1. Prior decision/care hours each remain counted once. Stock 20 kg retains 16 after supplies 2 and goods 2; four entitlement units and three independent school slots remain finite. Expectations are authored independently of the evaluator.

`governance-communication-v1.json` is a literal synthetic DOM-03/09 fixture.
Twelve cohort hours fund decision 3 and competing care 3, retaining one prior
hour each, leaving 6. The disjoint channel book starts with 5 message slots and
4 verification slots; one prior slot in each stays spent. A requests 3 (one
previously fulfilled) and receives 2 more; independent B requests 3 and receives
1, leaving channel 1 (reserved for B) and verification 0. A's approval dependency
names the exact target; B explicitly has no decision target. Fraction/integer
feasible sets verify conservation; neither slot allocation nor the three-tick
host-declared delay means a message was delivered or published.

`governance-participation-v1.json` is a literal synthetic DOM-03/11 fixture.
Twelve cohort hours fund decision 3 and competing care 3, each retaining one prior
hour, leaving 6. A separate hall has 5 participation slots. Two groups request 3
each; A retains one prior slot and receives 2 more, while independent B holds 2
reserved slots and receives 2, leaving zero hall capacity and B's unmet 1.
A explicitly requires approval for the exact decision target; B explicitly has
no target. Integer feasible sets and Fraction balances verify finite budgets.
Accommodation capacity does not imply attendance or modeled belief effects.

`governance-continuity-v1.json` is a literal synthetic DOM-03/12 fixture. Twelve
canonical time units fund three administrative and three care units, leaving six.
Five response slots include one prior commitment and a two-slot preparedness hold;
new response and preparedness allocations use two each, leaving zero and one
unmet preparedness unit. It asserts finite arithmetic and explicit prerequisites,
not delivered rescue, hazard likelihood, social effects or scientific validity.

`adjudication-care-v1.json` publishes `synthetic:adjudication-care@v1`.
Actual DOM-04 case work precedes canonical DOM-05 care on one 12-hour book.
Three hours of case work (including one prior), three of care (including one
prior), three training and three employment exhaust time. Four entitlement units
permit four of eight requested goods from twenty stock units. Two overlapping
arrangements contain the same ten people; membership creates no extra time.
Literal expected values and the independent integer/Fraction oracle verify finite
capacity, protected care holds, outcomes, unknowns and replay. No scientific or
nonauthor review, care outcomes, enforcement or source activation is claimed.

`adjudication-education-v1.json` is a synthetic actual DOM-04/06 finite-book
fixture: twelve time units fund case work, care, students, teachers and employment;
facility slots and prior commitments remain explicit. Independently authored
expectations and integer feasible-set/Fraction checks imply no learning or
scientific validity. Legal findings only restrict explicitly dependent new work.

`adjudication-health-v1.json` is the synthetic actual DOM-04/07 finite-book
fixture. Twelve dated time units contain three case work, three other care,
three patient care, two staff and one employment, retaining prior case/care work.
Two material units consume stock and entitlements; finite clinic slots include a
prior commitment. Literal expectations and an independent integer/Fraction oracle
check allocation, not treatment or scientific validity. Declared need, exposure
and health-state references remain explicit under every legal outcome.

`adjudication-communication-v1.json` is a synthetic actual DOM-04/09 fixture with
explicit legal dependence and independence, canonical dated case work and finite
disjoint channel/verification budgets. Literal expectations retain prior work,
message postings, protected holds and subtotals. Independent integer feasible-set
and Fraction oracles test competing message and procedural budgets; common
conformance executes reviewed context-bound actual evaluators. It is not legal,
scientific, delivery, publication or parent-gate evidence.

`adjudication-participation-v1.json` composes actual DOM-04 legal case work and
DOM-11 voluntary participation prerequisites. Independently authored quantities
retain prior legal/care work, prior participation use, a protected capacity hold
and subtotals: twelve time units contain three legal, three care and six retained;
five participation slots contain one prior, two new ritual and two new meeting.
The fixture and adversarial derivatives exercise actual reviewed host conformance,
unknowns/conflicts, case-specific mappings, voluntary declines and detached replay.

`adjudication-continuity-v1.json` composes actual DOM-04 case work with DOM-12
response-slot prerequisites. Independent literal quantities retain twelve hours
as three legal, three competing care and six remaining; five response slots
contain one prior use, two new preparedness and two new ordinary slots. A protected
ordinary hold prevents duplicate spending. Integer feasible-set/Fraction oracles,
local/regional scopes, case-specific findings and actual reviewed conformance
check finite commitments. Derivatives retain unknown vulnerability, authority,
disclosure and conditional external aid, plus withdrawal/replay. This synthetic
fixture establishes no rescue, hazard probability, enforcement or parent gate.

`governance-infrastructure-v1.json` is a literal synthetic DOM-03/08 fixture.
Twelve administration hours cover three decision hours, three competing care hours
and six retained hours, including prior use once. Five slots each in a facility,
bridge and road cover one prior use and four new uses; a protected two-slot
facility hold limits the first claimant. It establishes no maintenance, lifecycle
or delivered-service outcome. Independent feasible sets and Fraction balances
check finite work and path allocation in the actual evaluators.

`care-education-v1.json` is a literal synthetic DOM-05/06 fixture with the same
cohort in overlapping household/community membership, beneficiary care obligations,
student/staff/employment work, finite supplies/entitlements and independent facility
slots. Twelve hours include prior care once: care 3 + student 3 + staff 2 +
employment 4. Ten represented people remain ten across both arrangements. Explicit
alternate precedence can leave care unmet; no service or learning effect is claimed.
